title: Luxury Morocco Honeymoon – Romantic Itineraries & Riads
description: Plan the ultimate romantic escape: luxury riads, private desert camps, hot-air balloon rides, and candlelit dinners.
content:
## Dream Accommodations

Stay in a restored riad in Marrakech, a cliffside suite in Chefchaouen, and a private luxury tent in the Sahara.

## Romantic Experiences

- Private hot-air balloon at sunrise over Agafay
- Candlelit dinner under the stars in a desert camp
- Couple's hammam in a palace spa

## Sample 10-Day Itinerary

3 nights Marrakech → 2 nights Fes → 2 nights Chefchaouen → 2 nights Sahara → 1 night Casablanca

## Why Morocco?

Exotic yet accessible, safe, and filled with unforgettable moments. Morocco is one of the world's top honeymoon destinations.
